product_summary: Mumbai-based specialty chemicals house (est. 1981, GST 27AAACD2258G1ZV per own site). Two published ranges: (1) distribution/trading of third-party 'chemical giant' brands - Amines (AEEA, AEP, DETA, DEA, EDA, IPDA, MEA, polyetheramine, Primene 81R, GLYMO silane, TETA, TEPA, 2-EHA amine), Chlorinated solvents (ECH, PERC, TCE), Glycol ethers/esters (butyl cellosolve & carbitol ethers and acetates, Dowanol PM/DPM, PMA, PM, PG, DPG, propylene carbonate), Monomers (acrylic acid, BAM, Cardura E10P, MAA, MMA, VeoVa 10, NBMA, 2-HEA, 2-HEMA, 2-EHA, DMAEMA), Others (BPA, DMF, isophthalic acid, nonyl phenol, NPE, pentaerythritol, phenol, MDI/TDI polyols, THF, PVA); (2) own proprietary blends manufactured at Vasai (Maharashtra) and Pithampur (MP) - TETA Blend, DCBA 20, LEA Blend, PACM (para-aminocyclohexyl methane), PMA Blend. End-use sectors: cleaning, coatings, oil fields, paints, resins, water treatment, textiles, agrochemicals, pharma, adhesives.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader - self-described as 'Manufacturer, Supplier' and 'authorised distributor' of other producers' brands; own blend plant at Vasai/Pithampur plus a large traded/distributed portfolio. Trader signs: 'One-Stop House', 'authorised distributor of several Well-Known Chemical Giants', warehousing in India and UAE, brand names (Dowanol, Cardura, VeoVa, Primene, Wanamine) belonging to Dow/Hexion/Evonik/BASF.
comment: HS comparison: declared 290930 / 291590 / 291613 / 292111 vs published range. 291613 (methacrylic acid) - EXACT, corroborated by the company's own site (HS 2916131000). 291590 (other saturated acyclic mono-carboxylic acids and derivatives) - PARTIAL: covers the acrylate/methacrylate esters (291612/291614) and Cardura E10P/VeoVa 10 only loosely; the correct specific headings are 291611 (acrylic acid), 291612 (acrylate esters), 291614 (methacrylate esters), which the company itself quotes. 290930 (aromatic ethers) - PARTIAL/WRONG: the ether range is actually aliphatic glycol ethers (290943/290944/290949) and an ester (291539 PMA); 290930 fits none of the listed products. 292111 (methylamine, di- or trimethylamine) - WRONG: no methylamines appear anywhere in the published catalogue; the amine range is ethylenediamine (292121), polyamines (292122), ethanolamines (292211/292212), cycloaliphatic amines (292130). Major product lines MISSING from the declaration: chlorinated solvents (290319 PERC/TCE, 291030 epichlorohydrin), bisphenol A (290723), DMF (292419), isophthalic acid (291739), nonyl phenol and NPE (290713/340213), pentaerythritol (290542), phenol (290711), MDI/TDI (292910), THF (293211), PVA (390530), and the proprietary amine blends (TETA Blend, DCBA 20, LEA Blend, PACM, PMA Blend) which are mixtures and would normally classify by end-use/constituent rather than as pure compounds. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' is broadly consistent (oil-field chemicals, fuel/lube additives, asphalt additives are explicitly listed) but the company is a specialty-chemicals distributor/blender, not an upstream petrochemical producer. Data-quality note: the company's own site contains an obvious internal error - IPDA is given 'HS Code: 84713090' (that is a laptop/ADP machine heading) instead of 292130; this is a site typo, not a customs record. Per project rule 3, the HS discrepancies are NOT grounds for rejection - the company stays in the base and the codes are corrected to the actual range above. All product/HS statements here are from the company's own website (dhalop.com, dhalopchemicals.com) and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, B/L or shipping bill was examined in this review (out of scope), so no shipment is asserted. No registry, revenue or volume data was researched.
